metadata.title: Libertarian Forum — Libertarian Think Tank
metadata.description: A libertarian ideas laboratory producing research, analysis and strategy to build strong libertarian parties and movements.

hero.h1:
The ideas laboratory
that challenges the status quo
hero.description: The most powerful ideas about freedom deserve more than academic journals. We produce research, analysis and strategy to build strong libertarian parties and movements across the world.

research.title: Research
research.description: We publish essays, policy papers and analyses on individual freedom, free markets and limited government — grounded in rigorous scholarship and real-world application.

debate.title: Debate & Ideas
debate.description: We are an open forum where libertarian ideas are stress-tested, refined and strengthened. Intellectual debate is not just our method — it is our purpose.

advice.title: Strategic Advisory
advice.description: We partner with libertarian parties and movements to develop compelling political programs, communication strategies and long-term growth plans.

about.p1: Libertarian Forum is a think tank dedicated to advancing the ideas of individual freedom, free markets and limited government.
about.p2: We exist to bring the best libertarian ideas into the political arena, into public policy, and to the decision-makers who shape the lives of millions — with a special focus on Latin America.
about.p3: We are not a political party. We are the independent intellectual space where libertarian movements find their theoretical foundations, policy programs and growth strategy.

rigor.title: Academic Rigor
rigor.description: Every publication and analysis meets serious research standards, with solid sourcing and well-grounded argumentation.

freedom.title: Individual Freedom
freedom.description: We uphold the principle that every individual owns their life, their choices and the fruits of their labor.

state.title: Limited Government
state.description: We advocate for lean, efficient and transparent institutions that serve the citizen — not the other way around.

network.title: Global Network
network.description: We connect libertarian thinkers, activists and organizations worldwide to multiply our collective impact.

services.description: We offer specialized advisory services for political parties, movements and organizations working from first principles of freedom.

platforms.title: Policy Platforms
platforms.description: We develop comprehensive political programs grounded in libertarian principles, tailored to the specific context of each country or region.

marketing.title: Political Marketing
marketing.description: Communication and positioning strategies for libertarian parties and movements, focused on authenticity, coherence and effective persuasion.

consulting.title: Strategic Consulting
consulting.description: We guide organizations through institutional development: internal structure, member recruitment, electoral strategy and leadership building.

research.title: Research & Analysis
research.description: We conduct tailored research on politics, economics and libertarian political philosophy.

training.title: Training & Development
training.description: Training programs for activists, leaders and libertarian candidates. Workshops on libertarian thought, public speaking and communication.

essays.description: Original libertarian research and thinking applied to the political and economic challenges of our time.

soon.title: More publications on the way
soon.description: Subscribe to receive our new essays and analyses directly in your inbox.

items.title: The Individual vs. the State: Foundations of Modern Freedom
items.description: An analysis of the philosophical principles underpinning the libertarian tradition and their relevance in the 21st century.

items.title: Free Markets and Prosperity: Evidence and Arguments
items.description: Why economic freedom is the material foundation of human progress — with data and comparative analysis across political systems.

items.title: Building a Libertarian Movement from Scratch
items.description: A practical guide to organizing successful libertarian parties and movements in both democratic and non-democratic contexts.

items.title: The Libertarian Resurgence in Latin America: Context and Perspectives
items.description: Analysis of the growth of libertarian movements in Latin America, their causes and prospects for consolidation as a relevant political force.

cta.description: Whether you are launching a party, growing a movement, or developing policy from first principles — we bring the intellectual firepower and strategic experience to help you succeed.

footer.tagline: The libertarian ideas laboratory that challenges political and academic paradigms.

aboutPage.h1:
The think tank that brings freedom
into the political debate
aboutPage.intro: We are a ideas laboratory dedicated to researching, debating and promoting the ideas of individual freedom, free markets and limited government.
aboutPage.p1: Libertarian Forum was born from the conviction that the best ideas about freedom should not remain in books. We exist to bring them into the political debate, into public policy, and to the decision-makers who affect millions.
aboutPage.p2: We are a discussion forum and ideas laboratory where libertarian thought is researched, debated and refined. We produce essays, policy platforms, political analyses and strategy to build strong libertarian parties and movements.
aboutPage.mission: To promote and develop the ideas of individual freedom, private property and limited government through rigorous research, open intellectual debate and strategic advisory to libertarian organizations.
aboutPage.vision: A world where the ideas of freedom are the basis of political and economic systems, where the individual is the center of every social organization and the State is truly a servant and not an owner of citizens.

servicesPage.intro: We offer specialized advisory in research, strategy and political communication for libertarian parties and organizations.

essaysPage.intro: Original libertarian research and thinking applied to the political, economic and institutional challenges of our time.

contactPage.intro: If you are organizing a movement or political party from libertarian first principles, we work with you.
